description: Execute approved or scoped non-UI work safely after b-plan approval, when a user gives a small direct request or an approved plan. Applies the next small step, verifies it, and hands back to planning or research instead of guessing when new ambiguity appears. Frontend/UI code—pages, layouts, components, styling, responsive behavior, interactions, or visual refreshes—belongs to b-frontend instead. Unlike b-plan, b-implement changes code. Routing signals: implement, make the change, apply the plan, code the fix, finish the implementation, build the feature.
